title: KAKA COST A REPORTED €67M AT REAL MADRID. 29 GOALS IN 120 GAMES
description:
From 1,047 World Player votes to a Spanish radio list. Kaka's story has two halves.

Kaka won the Ballon d'Or in 2007. In the FIFA World Player vote that year he took 1,047 votes. Messi had 504 and Ronaldo 426.

Then Real Madrid, reportedly for 67 million euros in 2009. He scored 29 goals and made 32 assists in 120 games. That's roughly a million euros each. A Spanish radio show put him in its worst-signings top five, though that's one radio opinion, not an official ranking.

2013 brought two yellows in 18 minutes against Osasuna, and a red card. Efficient. Orlando City reportedly paid him the top salary in MLS. Orlando missed the playoffs in 2015, 2016 and 2017.

So what do you remember most about Kaka: the 2007 peak or the Madrid years? Pick one in the comments.
